description: This file defines the DeviceStatusService class, which provides various device status information such as battery, thermal, storage, network, and device info. It implements the DeviceStatusServicing protocol and utilizes system APIs to gather device-specific data.

classes.name: DeviceStatusService
classes.description: A service class that provides device status information such as battery, thermal, storage, network status, and device info.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously gathers device status data including battery, thermal, storage, network status, and system uptime, returning an OpenClawDeviceStatusPayload.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns a payload with device information such as device name, model, OS version, app version/build, and locale.

methods.name: batteryStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current battery level and state, and whether low power mode is enabled.

methods.name: thermalStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current thermal state of the device.

methods.name: storageStatus
methods.description: Retrieves total, free, and used storage space on the device.

methods.name: fallbackAppBuild
methods.description: Provides a fallback value for app build string if empty.
